summary.intent: Coordinate several subagents that resolve merge conflicts and review findings on multiple caliper PRs (#323, #327, #335/#345, #348/#349/#353, #362), and report on their status.
summary.outcome: PR #362 was merged with main, pushed, and verified by the assistant with all CI checks passing. PR #327 was merged with main, pushed, and its one finding fixed, but CI was still pending. Other workers (#323, #335/#345, #348/#349/#353) were still running.

repo: Branches checked out in other worktrees can't be reused, so workers create local branches (e.g. m327, m362) and push with `git push origin <local>:<remote-branch>`.
Worktrees use a symlinked node_modules; `pnpm --filter ... test` refuses with ERR_PNPM_UNSAFE_TASK_RUN_STATE_PATH, so run the vitest binary directly from apps/oracle.

Seven core snapshot tests (snapshot_chakra, mantine, mui, panda, radix, rdt_compat, shadcn) fail in worktrees, apparently because the [ROOT] path prefix differs. Generated *.snap.new files must be deleted and not committed.
Config-loader tests in crates/cli fail in worktrees with `Cannot find package 'tsx'` (the 7 config::tests and 3 commands tests).
Sandboxed nextest runs stop early (watch_process failures) and pass unsandboxed; use --no-fail-fast and run unsandboxed.
The standard local gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`, plus `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'` (142 tests).
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION was 29 on main, and the #327 branch never bumped it, so no golden-file edit was needed.
The CLI help snapshot crates/cli/tests/cmd/extract_help.trycmd is regenerated with TRYCMD=overwrite.
Main's docs/measurement.md claimed a 30-prop collapse threshold that contradicts the branch's ADR 0012 behavior (dependencies-only collapse plus a 200-prop valve); the branch wording was kept.

code.finding: Four #[arg] doc comments (lines 127, 203, 227, 255) wrongly said a dependency's API is always listed; they now say it is listed unless it declares more than 200 props, matching packages/vite-plugin/src/options.ts:30 (LARGE_API_SOURCE).
The merge conflict was resolved by keeping both assertSchemaVersion(JSON.parse(...), 'caliper JSON') from schema-version.ts and checkCaliperShape(caliper) from caliper-input.ts.
Defines its own SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4, duplicating schema-version.ts. The Rust schema.rs drift test pins only schema-version.ts, so the copy could drift.

workflow: Subagent hand-back messages and task notifications can arrive duplicated; recognize repeats and don't re-process them.
Verify a subagent's CI claims independently (e.g. `gh pr checks`) before reporting a PR as resolved.
Don't claim failing tests pass; the workers did not confirm the 17 failures also fail on main, so they were reported as unverified environment artifacts.

friction: GitHub Actions on #327 stayed pending for about 30 minutes with no check starting, so CI could not verify it.
17 test failures on #327 (7 snapshot, 10 config-loader) and 7 on #362 are attributed to the worktree environment, and none were confirmed against main.
The sandbox caused spurious test failures and early test-run termination.
pnpm refused to run in a worktree with a symlinked node_modules.
The #327 report arrived three times, along with duplicate task notifications, adding noise.
open_items: Re-run `gh pr checks 327` and re-list findings once CI finishes on #327.
Make caliper-input.ts import SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION from schema-version.ts instead of duplicating it (not yet done).
Check whether #335 is merged; the #327 worker did not.
Confirm the 7 snapshot failures (and the 10 config-loader failures on #327) also fail on main, to prove they are environment artifacts.
Workers for #323, #335/#345 and #348/#349/#353 are still running and need to be collected.
The untracked node_modules symlinks in worktrees were left uncommitted and may need cleanup.
